findings.evidence: Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:43-44 `/-- Momentum of the produced real photon (DVCS) or meson (DVMP). -/ qPrime : V` (unchanged by this PR); xiSkew at line 76 and Diffractive.xi at Diffractive/Basic.lean:73 are both functions of `ExclKinematics V`; roadmap README.md:107-111 Convention 1.
findings.fix: Widen the `qPrime` field docstring (and the `ExclKinematics` structure docstring) to state both readings — produced photon/meson for DVCS/DVMP, system X for diffraction — and add one line to `Diffractive.xi`'s docstring saying it is the target momentum-loss fraction and is not `ExclKinematics.xiSkew`.
findings.issue: The PR widens ExclKinematics to carry diffractive events but leaves its field documentation at the narrower DVCS/DVMP reading: `qPrime` is still documented as "Momentum of the produced real photon (DVCS) or meson (DVMP)", while the new file reads the same field as the whole diffractive system X. The consequence is that for one `K : ExclKinematics V` both `K.xiSkew g` (skewness, whose docstring presumes `q'² = 0`) and `Diffractive.xi g K` (momentum fraction lost by the target) typecheck and are both "the ξ of K", with nothing in the API distinguishing them — the exact confusion Diffraction roadmap Convention 1 names as the trap to avoid.

findings.evidence: Diffractive/Basic.lean:85-89; roadmap README.md:279 `M_X² = (q + Δ)²`; Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:91-94 `delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime : K.delta = K.q - K.qPrime`, hence `K.qPrime = K.q - K.delta`.
findings.fix: Replace the `rfl` `MX2_def` with the content lemma `MX2 g K = g (K.q - K.delta) (K.q - K.delta)` (i.e. `(q + Δ)²` with `Δ = -delta`), provable from `ExclKinematics.delta_eq_q_sub_qPrime`.
findings.issue: `MX2` is defined as `g K.qPrime K.qPrime` and its only lemma `MX2_def` is `rfl` marked `@[simp]`, so `MX2` is unfolded out of every goal and carries no content. The roadmap's definition is `M_X² = (q + Δ)²`, and the docstring asserts `q' = q + Δ` but no lemma proves it, so the invariant form is not available downstream.

summary: Hypotheses and the x = ξβ statement sit at the right level (no symmetry, no spurious p·q ≠ 0). Two level problems: ExclKinematics is reused for diffraction without widening its documented scope, leaving two different momentum fractions named ξ on one type, and MX2 is stated in the narrow qPrime form with no lemma giving the roadmap's invariant (q + Δ)².
